title: Kongo language | Bantu, Central Africa, Dialects | Britannica
text: Kongo language, a Bantu language of the Benue-Congo branch of the Niger-Congo language family. Kongo is related to Swahili, Shona, and Bembe, among others. Kikongo is the name used by its speakers.
